description: Runs a Monte Carlo simulation (thousands of trials) estimating the odds your savings and contributions support your stated retirement income target. It does not assume a fixed withdrawal rule such as the 4% rule; you state your target income and the tool reports the odds under each named forward-looking scenario (historical baseline, regime transition, AI-productivity acceleration, structural stagnation). A free preview shows the success rate under one scenario; the full multi-scenario comparison and percentile detail need a plugin subscription.

annual_contribution.description: Amount contributed per year, in today's (real) dollars, during the years between current_age and retirement_age

current_savings.description: Current portfolio balance in today's (real) dollars

desired_annual_retirement_income.description: Your own target annual retirement income in today's (real) dollars — required; this tool will not assume a withdrawal rate for you

equity_weight.description: Fraction of the portfolio in equity-like assets, 0-1 (default 0.6)

retirement_age.description: The age you plan to retire and begin withdrawals

scenario.description: A single scenario id to run one scenario only — omit to see the full range (subscription required)

name: retirement.monte_carlo_estimator
title: Retirement Cash-Flow Monte Carlo Estimator
